title: Storage Health & Debloater Overhaul
headline: Drive optimization is now built into the Cleaner, and the Debloater gets a full premium visual redesign with animated scan overlay, batch panels, and a results dashboard.
changes: New: Storage Health section in Cleaner — monitor NVMe, SSD, and HDD drives with animated free-space gauges, TRIM/defrag recommendations, and one-click optimization.
New: Drive optimization history — every TRIM and defrag run is logged with timestamp and drive info, visible directly in the Cleaner.
New: AI Advisor integration in Storage Health — contextual drive insights shown inline, with a quick link to ask the AI Advisor for deeper analysis.
New: Debloater premium scan overlay — a multi-step animated scan experience replaces the plain loading state.

New: Debloater batch panels — four large action cards (Safe, Recommended, Aggressive, Maximum Performance) replace the old intensity buttons with gradient backgrounds, glow borders, and detailed descriptions.
New: Debloater results dashboard — animated donut chart, score gauge, and subtle confetti on scan complete.
Improved: Debloater stat cards now animate counters on load (apps removable, estimated RAM freed, live processes, estimated disk freed).
Improved: Storage Health shows a live demo on the web app (Samsung 990 Pro + Seagate BarraCuda) so the feature is always visible without the desktop app.
